name: read_screen_text
description: Reads text content from a specified UI element, window, or container using Windows UIAutomation accessibility trees without performing hardware manipulation or OCR.

target.description: The logical name, AutomationId, or window title of the UI element or container to read from the accessibility tree.

rationale.description: REQUIRED. A concise explanation of why you are inspecting the screen text and what information you intend to retrieve.
